title: Behind-the-Meter Data Center Generation
summary: On-site power generation co-located with AI data centers (nuclear SMRs, gas peakers, fuel cells) ...
bodyHtml:
What This Is

On-site power generation co-located with AI data centers (nuclear SMRs, gas peakers, fuel cells) to bypass congested grid interconnection queues; DOE priority in 2026..

Pilot deployments and early-stage commercial testing underway. Technology is proven at small scale. Our research database tracks 1 independent source on this technology.

DOE invoked emergency powers in early 2026 to shift data centers to backup generation during peak demand. Behind-the-meter generation becoming priority as grid interconnection queues reach 7 years in Virginia. Allianz Research 2026.
